title: Puzzle 3d Brush Fill Suggest Camera Stable
description: Fix puzzle3d camera jumping when object is suggested or brush or fill is started. Camera should stay where it was.
summary: Fixed puzzle3d camera jumping when brush, fill, or suggest-object flows start. Root cause: WorldOrbitCameraViewRigSeed re-applied pinned camera props whenever the Three.js camera remounted (new uuid) even when cameraSeedKey was unchanged — common when tool activation triggers scene subtree remounts. Changed apply-once gate to token-only (seed+projection) via shouldApplyOrbitCameraViewRigSeed, matching OrbitCameraViewSeed and the prior CAD play fix intent. Also suppress AutoFit while brush or fill tools are active (puzzle3dFillToolActiveRef + brush tool ref in puzzle3dBrushSessionActive). Tests: shouldApplyOrbitCameraViewRigSeed in @infinite/world/r3f; extended puzzle3dBrushSessionActive coverage in @puzzle/3d/react. Vitest: 60 passed (r3f), 348 passed (puzzle3d react).
